**What's there:** Six confirmed IT events in Verona for 2026, with 18 inline citations:

| When | Event | Cost |
|------|-------|------|
| Apr 16–17 | AgrifoodTech Hackathon (students/researchers) | Free |
| Apr 20–22 | DATE 2026 — EDA/chip design, ~1,500 attendees | reg. req. |
| May 14–15 | phpday 2026 (23rd ed., PHP/backend) | €399 + VAT |
| Oct 1 | UseCaseConf 2026 (enterprise IT, vendor-neutral) | Free |
| Nov 19 | reactjsday 2026 (12th ed., React) | €249.99 + VAT |
| Nov 20 | angularday 2026 (10th ed., Angular) | €249.99 + VAT |

The GrUSP November double-header (reactjsday + angularday, consecutive days at Hotel San Marco) stands out as the best reason for a developer weekend trip — early bird tickets bring both days to ~€180 + VAT combined.
